exact_declarations.exact_signature:
theorem prune_source_forest (s : State V E Copy) (hs : Valid s) (keep : Finset Copy) :
    pruneForest keep (sourceUnrankedForest s Finset.univ) = sourceUnrankedForest s keep

theorem actual_complete_unranked_all_panel_projectivity (N : RootedBinary V E X)
    (C : GProgram.G5.Calendar N.graph) (sample : Copy → X) (keep : Finset Copy)
    (H : OriginalParentRegistry N) (p : HybridProbabilities N)
    (common : Hybrid N → Bool) (r : PositivePairRates E) :
    (naturalCompletedLaw N C sample H p common r).map
      (fun s => sourceUnrankedForest (state s) keep) =
      (naturalCompletedUnrankedLaw N C (selectedSample sample keep) H p common r).map
        (fun F => F.image (mapUnranked Subtype.val))

theorem actual_controlled_complete_unranked_all_panel_projectivity (N : RootedBinary V E X)
    (C : GProgram.G5.Calendar N.graph) (sample : Copy → X) (keep : Finset Copy)
    (H : OriginalParentRegistry N) (p : HybridProbabilities N)
    (common : Hybrid N → Bool) (r : PositivePairRates E) (mask : OriginalMask N) :
    (controlledCompletedLaw N C sample H p common r mask).map
      (fun s => sourceUnrankedForest (state s) keep) =
    (controlledCompletedUnrankedLaw N C (selectedSample sample keep) H p common r mask).map
      (fun F => F.image (mapUnranked Subtype.val))

theorem empty_mask_completed_original_law (N : RootedBinary V E X)
    (C : GProgram.G5.Calendar N.graph) (sample : Copy → X) (H : OriginalParentRegistry N)
    (p : HybridProbabilities N) (common : Hybrid N → Bool) (r : PositivePairRates E) :
    controlledCompletedLaw N C sample H p common r (fun _ => none) =
      naturalCompletedLaw N C sample H p common r

theorem actual_legal_comb_probability (N : RootedBinary V E X) (C : Calendar N.graph)
    (H : OriginalParentRegistry N) (p : HybridProbabilities N) (r : PositivePairRates E)
    (i j : X) (k : Nat) (hk : 0 < k) :
    legalCombProbability N C H p r i j k =
      naturalCompletedUnrankedLaw N C (repeatedSample k i j) H p (fun _ => true) r
        {toUnranked (comb (Sum.inr ()) (canonicalA k))}

lemma controlled_full_panel_comb_real (N : RootedBinary V E X) (C : Calendar N.graph)
    (H : OriginalParentRegistry N) (p : HybridProbabilities N) (r : PositivePairRates E)
    (mask : OriginalMask N) (i j : X) (sample : Copy → X)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective sample) (keep : Finset Copy)
    (b : SelectedCopy keep) (hb : sample b.val = j)
    (ha : ∀ x : SelectedCopy keep, x ≠ b → sample x.val = i)
    (as : List (SelectedCopy keep)) (hcover : ∀ x, x = b ∨ x ∈ as)
    (hnodup : as.Nodup) (hnot : b ∉ as) (hne : as ≠ []) :
    (((controlledFullForestLaw N C H p r mask sample).map (pruneForest keep))
      {toUnranked (comb b.val (as.map Subtype.val))}).toReal =
      combCoefficient as.length * finiteBankMoment (originalRegisterMeasure N p).toPMF
        (fun coin => directedSurvival (maskedNormalizedTree N C H r mask coin) i j) as.length

lemma randomizedLegalCombMoment_eq_internal_average
    (N : RootedBinary V E X) (C : Calendar N.graph) (H : OriginalParentRegistry N)
    (p : HybridProbabilities N) (r : PositivePairRates E)
    (ν : PMF Config) (masks : Config → OriginalMask N) (i j : X) (k : Nat) :
    randomizedLegalCombMoment N C H p r ν masks i j k =
      ∑ cfg, (ν cfg).toReal * controlledLegalCombMoment N C H p r (masks cfg) i j k

lemma actual_randomized_legal_moment
    (N : RootedBinary V E X) (C : Calendar N.graph) (H : OriginalParentRegistry N)
    (p : HybridProbabilities N) (r : PositivePairRates E)
    (ν : PMF Config) (masks : Config → OriginalMask N) (i j : X) (k : Nat) (hk : 0 < k) :
    randomizedLegalCombMoment N C H p r ν masks i j k =
      finiteBankMoment (configurationBankPMF ν (originalRegisterMeasure N p).toPMF)
        (fun z => directedSurvival (maskedNormalizedTree N C H r (masks z.1) z.2) i j) k
